connectors.connection_failed: The connection test failed. Check the CLI profile, user authorization, and target folder.
connectors.empty: No publishing targets yet. Install and configure the official lark-cli outside this app, then use the read-only check above to select an existing profile and target folder.
connectors.editor_stale: This publishing target was removed or changed. Reopen the editor.
connectors.upload_scope: Markdown is created as a native Feishu Drive Markdown file; HTML is uploaded as a self-contained .html file. The app does not overwrite automatically, convert to Docx, or provide two-way sync.

guide.entry_title: Connect Feishu for the first time
guide.entry_description: Check the existing CLI and user profile, then choose a target folder. Installation, configuration, and login happen outside this app.
guide.title: Feishu CLI read-only check
guide.description: Three steps. The app only checks an installed CLI and existing user profile. It does not create, modify, or switch profiles or initiate login.
guide.external_setup_notice: Install the official lark-cli 1.0.96 or a newer 1.x release, configure a profile, and sign in outside this app using the official documentation. This page does not scan for you or change shared CLI settings.
guide.install_description: Confirm the official tool is installed and compatible
guide.install_body: Confirm the official lark-cli is installed outside this app. The check only reads its version, existing profiles, and the selected user identity.
guide.profile_description: Verify the user identity managed by the CLI, without changing it
guide.profile_hint: Keep seo-publisher or use up to 64 characters without spaces or command punctuation.
guide.profile_invalid: Use a short profile name without spaces or command-special characters.
guide.profile_external_hint: If the profile is missing or its user login expired, handle that independently in the official CLI outside this app, then select I finished — check again.
guide.folder_description: Paste the full URL and let the app extract its token
guide.folder_hint: Open a dedicated folder in Feishu Drive and copy its browser URL, or enter the fldcn… token directly.
guide.folder_invalid: This is not a Feishu Drive folder URL. Do not paste a document, Wiki, Sheet, or Base URL.
guide.folder_scope: The Drive root has no folder token. Create a dedicated folder yourself and ensure the selected user can create files there.
guide.form_prefilled: The check filled the form. Confirm its name and format, save it, then run the read-only connection test.

connectors.delete_body: Delete “{{name}}”? Only the local non-secret target settings are removed. The shared CLI profile and login are untouched, and historical publishing records remain.

form.name: Connector name
form.cli_profile_hint: Enter a profile already configured in lark-cli. Identity is fixed to user.
form.folder_token_hint: Get the folder token from the target Feishu Drive folder URL.

feedback.saved: {{name}} was saved. No external request was made.
feedback.connection_ok: {{name}} connected successfully. The target folder is accessible and no file was created.
feedback.deleted: {{name}} was deleted. The shared CLI profile was not changed.
feedback.deleted_cleanup_pending: {{name}} was deleted. Cleanup of a legacy app secret will retry in the background; the CLI profile was not changed.

runs.title: Run History
runs.description: Review status, progress, and timing for the latest 100 batches.
runs.load_failed: Run history could not be read.
runs.empty_description: Select articles in the workbench and start generating to create a batch here.

settings.host_state_failed: Some system settings could not be read. You can retry; switches will not pretend to be enabled.
settings.language_failed: The language preference could not be saved. The interface keeps its current language.
